title: Voice dictation
oneLine: Talk, and text appears wherever your cursor is.
why: Open-source speech models (Whisper and its faster variants) are as good as the paid apps for plain dictation. Wiring one to a hotkey is a one-afternoon build and it runs entirely on your machine.
tool: faster-whisper plus a small script; Claude Code or Gemini CLI writes the glue
keep: Automatic formatting, the AI 'clean up what I said' layer, phone support.
breaks: Microphone permissions reset after OS updates. Larger models are slow without a GPU.
